what: The census v1 denominator moved during the Wave 2 integration. A denominator that moves silently is the defect the freeze exists to prevent, so the movement is recorded here with its exact cause before the freeze was retaken.
causedBy: Installing the service branches R2_ALREADY_ANSWERED_ENGINEERING derived from controlling decision records into src/lib/legal-authority/routes/**. The census promotes every service branch to a typed obligation, so a branch identity is a census row.
refrozenOn: the current Captain head, which is the freeze generator's own stated basis
whyThisMovementIsSafe: Category A did not move. No new build obligation, packet family or legal-review question was created.
Every added obligation is a Category B legitimate exclusion: automatic relief, guidance status or referral.
Packet families held at 352 and the legal-review queue held at 86.
Commercial routes opened: 0. Every installed branch carries a null packet family, so the runtime derivation closes it.

whatWasDeferredRatherThanMoved.why: A packet-bearing branch would have created a Category A terminal obligation, and three contracts are pinned runtime-contract cohorts whose exact branch enumeration the census verifier asserts. Those identities are carried in the Wave 2 residual instead of installed.
